fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 16 ft aluminum fishing boat with outboard and trailer.
findings: Fresh glossy red paint on both sides of the hull with no visible dullness or oxidation
Gray carpeted floors and casting decks look clean and new
Seats and console look clean and recently replaced
Minor scuffing visible on the transom area near the motor mount and on the Evinrude cowling
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the restored Alumacraft and it looks sharp, the fresh red paint and new carpet really show well. If you want it extra crisp for showings, we offer a pre-sale wash and wax that comes to you, including the hull and the motor cowling. Would you like a quote?
